scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date regardless of Assessment Date
gaps: Status field 'Edge' for id 'TC_TS001_003' fails check 12 because no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record; quoted Status: 'Edge'

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with Assessment Date change uses Assessment Date as transaction effective date
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS002_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples of non-qualifying Expected Result text include "The transmission shows an accepted processing path without rejection for the same-day changed Assessment Date." and "No TechnicalErrorDescription824 row is returned for the submitted control number."

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes updates effective date but preserves relevant field values
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS003_003", but no step has an Expected Result describing an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The same-day boundary update is processed successfully, the transaction effective date in Facets equals the changed same-day Assessment Date, the relevant field values remain unchanged, unit and integration flow are evidenced by successful processing records, and execution screenshots are captured."

scenarios.title: Future eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id "TC_TS004_003", but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Examples checked include "The canonical file is generated and reflects the exact boundary-condition values submitted in the inbound 834." and "No unexpected MELC exception row is created for the successful edge-case file, no blocking crosswalk mismatch is present, and the completed FACETS update uses the future Eligibility Date as the transaction effective date even at the one-day-before-start boundary while the Assessment Date stays unchanged."

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date only in allowed case
gaps: Status field is "Edge" for id TC_TS_005_003, but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The mocked 834 file contains a current-eligibility update with unchanged Assessment Date, changed Pregnancy value, and DTP*303 equal to the member eligibility start date."

scenarios.title: Date identification and first-occurrence handling support selective effective-date population without finance regression
gaps: Status field is "Edge" but no Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record in this test case. Example Expected Result: "FACETS reflects 20241001 as the transaction-driving effective date and no row indicates override by 20241015, 20241020, or 20240925."
